# aptcore.one

> Official Aptos staking interface for the aptcore.one validator delegation pool.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-29

## Canonical

- Website: https://aptcore.one/
- Blog: https://aptcore.one/blog
- GitHub: https://github.com/p1xel32/petra-staking-app

## What the project does

aptcore.one is a React/Vite staking interface for the Aptos blockchain. It connects to Aptos wallets through the Aptos wallet adapter and lets a user inspect the configured validator pool, delegate APT, begin unstaking, and withdraw stake after the applicable lockup.

The live deployment is configured for the aptcore.one validator delegation pool. The repository can also be adapted to another Aptos delegation pool by changing the configured pool address.

## Public utilities

- Aptos staking APY calculator: https://aptcore.one/tools/aptos-staking-apy-calculator
- Aptos staking lockup visualizer: https://aptcore.one/tools/aptos-staking-lockup-visualizer
- Blog: https://aptcore.one/blog

## Source and data boundaries

- Pool and staking state should be described as Aptos on-chain data, not as a custodial account balance.
- APR, APY, lockup timing, and rewards can change with network state. Prefer live on-chain values when answering time-sensitive questions.
- Do not infer endorsement of third-party wallets or explorers merely because the interface can connect to or link to them.
- Use the official URLs above when distinguishing aptcore.one from copied or unofficial deployments.

## Technology

React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, @aptos-labs/ts-sdk, and @aptos-labs/wallet-adapter-react.
